'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Government of Ethiopia]] says that the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] has begun an offensive into the [[Wag Hemra Zone|Wag]] and [[Welkait]] regions and is also pushing forward towards the [[Ethiopia–Sudan border|Sudanese border]]. Tigrayan authorities say that three [[airstrike]]s have hit the Tigrayan capital of [[Mekelle]], nearly striking a hospital. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/air-strike-hits-hospital-ethiopias-tigray-region-health-official-2022-08-31/ (Reuters)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/health-official-air-strike-hits-capital-of-ethiopia-s-tigray-region/6723811.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Fourteen people are killed and several others are kidnapped as [[Allied Democratic Forces]] militants attack a village in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Five attackers are also killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamists-kill-least-14-civilians-east-congo-attack-2022-08-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Gazprom]] announces the complete shutdown of the [[Nord Stream 1]] natural gas pipeline for three days for unscheduled maintenance. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62732835 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed and several others are injured after a semi truck crashes near a school in [[Bekasi]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/ten-killed-indonesia-truck-crash-outside-school-2022-08-31/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and 50 others are injured by a hailstorm in [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. This is the first direct hail-related death in Europe since 1997. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62736383 (BBC News)]
*The [[Suez Canal]] was temporarily blocked after a ship ran aground on Wednesday evening. Tug boats were used to unblock the canal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ship-runs-aground-egypts-suez-canal-sources-2022-08-31/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and six others are injured after a [[Structural integrity and failure|building collapse]] in [[Kano (city)|Kano]], [[Kano State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-nigeria-emergency-management-building-collapses-bdfbdcf611ee54faacb628cbad94bdd4 (AP)] 
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The [[National Cabinet (Australia)|National Cabinet]] agrees to lower the mandatory isolation period for people infected with COVID-19 to 5 days if an individual is asymptomatic at that time. However workers in high-risk settings are still required to isolate for 7 days. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-08-31/covid-isolation-requirements-shortened-to-five-days/101389766 (ABC News)]
*[[Sweden]] reports its first case of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] in a [[porpoise]]. [https://phys.org/news/2022-08-world-case-bird-flu-porpoise.amp (Phys)]
*[[Life expectancy]] in the United States decreases for the second consecutive year, falling by nearly a year from 2020 values. [https://apnews.com/article/covid-science-health-pandemics-centers-for-disease-control-and-prevention-0807d52898e7b01b4cb9be8addc5c191/ (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–European Union relations]]
***[[European Union]] foreign ministers agree to suspend a [[Travel visa|visa facilitation agreement]] with [[Russia]], making it more difficult and more expensive for Russian tourists to enter the EU. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/08/31/EU-ministers-agree-to-suspend-Russian-visa-facilitation-deal (Al Arabiya)]
